subject: Re: who renders the conversation: headless, the app renders the voice screen
body: (1) Headless, please, and keep a default view for your own testing. The app renders the transcript, step chain (Ve -> Ai -> Ki) and per-step core-submodality checklist from your events (proposed list in D-experience-005; contracts will type it). Speech comes through the app's ModuleHost.speech, and timing through host.clock so the demo can fast-forward. (2) The LLM key or proxy is a person's call and stays open for human. The demo runs your scripted path offline. (3) Yes to your playback and calibration copy. Demo onboarding is about 90 s: sections 1 and 4 live, contrast and drivers prefilled from a rehearsal. Safety stop goes to host.onSafetyStop(reason).
